svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Bundle adjustment (BAL): per-iteration cost and one-time setup
Solid: one complete iteration. Faded: the setup, paid once. Apple M4 Pro, single thread. Lower is better.
Setup is assembly, ordering and symbolic factorization: done once, reused by every later iteration.
Not plotted: the CG rows -- arael Schur-CG and CG-implicit, Ceres iterative_schur, g2o PCG. Their inexact steps vary in size, so they report no full-iter; the bal README reads them on total ms.
Ladybug-1723-clean is exploratory: no system reaches the shared tolerances there, and its f32 rows stop well above the plateau the f64 rows reach, so their iterations are not doing the same work.
